author: Aerosmith
body:
Well, the time has come! Panzor and I have finally done it. Welcome the new Trinity II!

So here are some things we've done:
Removed:
-Side Middle Islands
-Underlying Archer Areas (Areas with Vines)
-Two Monuments

Added:
-New Center Islands for each side

Give us your suggestions and thoughts in the comments! Well... Here it is! Trinity II!

Downloads: http://www.mediafire.com/download/mr5l4l2ss58m4t7/Trinity+2.0.zip
Album: http://imgur.com/a/naFX6
YML (Props to Newcleus): http://pastebin.com/iAhcBeLv

replies.author: steven5703
replies.body:
Congratulations!

Your map has been accepted for testing on the Avicus Network and it will appear in our Map Repository given you provide us a Download Link and a YML file for your map. After testing, you shall be notified whether your map was or wasn't introduced into rotations. Please avoid any questions regarding date of testing unless more than two weeks have passed.

Thanks for your map submission! :D

But I do have to agree with the others, about it not being a big difference from Trinity 1. Maybe you could just update Trinity 1 with Trinity 2 instead of having a separate map?
